name: Kon'ya, Oji-sama ni Dakaremasu...
original_name: 今夜、おじ様に抱かれます…
source: Hina has admired Takeru since childhood. However, Takeru marries Hina's sister, making him a more distant figure in her life. She's still happy to be working alongside him as a teacher at the same school. Unfortunately, Takeru's father, Gouzou, becomes aware of Hina's feelings. Although she has a youthful face, her body is maturing as a woman. Gouzou sets a trap to make Hina his own.
translation: 希娜从小就崇拜武。然而，Takeru与Hina的妹妹结婚，使他在她的生活中变得更加遥远。她仍然很高兴能和他一起在同一所学校当老师。不幸的是，Takeru的父亲Gouzou意识到了Hina的感受。尽管她有着年轻的面孔，但她的身体却作为一个女人正在成熟。豪三设下陷阱，想要将希娜据为己有。
